description: This file provides utility functions within the 'Utils' namespace for synchronizing and persisting files and JSON settings, including methods to open files, flush data, and save JSON objects to files.

methods.name: void syncPersistFile(const string file)
methods.description: Synchronizes a file by opening it, flushing its buffers, syncing data to disk, and then closing it.

methods.name: void persistJsonSettings(const string strFile,const string strKey,const JsonValue & jsValue)
methods.description: Persists a JSON setting associated with a key in a specified file, creating or updating the JSON object within the file.
